title: Attempts 1-11 of this very tick left no exec-state reports, so attempt 12 could not have been shown them
body: Under the production ExecStateRoot for this run (~/.ticfac/exec/local-subprocess/runs/epic-9pd/nvn/), only attempt 12 has a state directory; attempts 1-11 left none, so their prose is not on disk anywhere the new discoverer reads. That is consistent with those attempts having run through a different channel (the tk herd runner) or a different state root, not with a bug in 35h's archiving — but it means this tick's feature, merged mid-epic, will first pay off for attempts dispatched after it under this run id. Worth confirming where the earlier attempts' reports actually live before relying on the feature for cross-channel re-dispatches.
